description: Three red plastic cups sit on a light wooden table against plain walls, with both hands hovering nearby. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the rightmost cup (right-hand object), lifts it, and brings it over the other cups while the left hand slides in to steady the left cup (left-hand object); the right hand nests the lifted cup into the left cup, then picks up the remaining cup and stacks it into the same pile, leaving a single stacked set centered on the table.
